questions.prompt: What is the goal of shaft alignment?
questions.answer: Both shafts rotate about the same centerline
options: Both shafts rotate about the same centerline
Both shafts have the same length
Both motors have the same voltage
questions.explanation: Aligned centerlines reduce vibration and unnecessary wear.

reviewCue.text: Find the passage below on the review slide. Focus on the component, condition, or relationship it describes.
reviewCue.excerpt: Both shafts rotate around the exact same centerline. When the centerlines are aligned: • Bearings run cooler • Couplings last longer • Vibration drops • Energy efficiency improves • Machine life increases • This is the core principle behind all alignment work.…

questions.prompt: What are the three combinations of shaft-centerline misalignment?
questions.explanation: Offset is parallel misalignment; angled centerlines are angular; both can occur together.
